title: Positive and negative coordinate counts
statement: For any finite set $S$ of coordinates and any sign vector $x$, the number of coordinates in $S$ where $x$ is $+1$ plus the number where it is $-1$ equals $|S|$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a finite set of coordinates
